assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The patient has a history of unspecified cardiac arrhythmia.
There is a need to correlate symptoms with potential rhythm disturbances over an extended period.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is indicated to evaluate for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other significant arrhythmias.
The required precertification was not obtained before services were rendered.
The appeal requests authorization for the medically necessary diagnostic procedure.
